groups.title: Tier one · the estate speaks true

part.title: Load-bearing truth
part.blurb: What the record must not misrepresent: the cooperative’s formation standing, the correction log, the honesty of the parked doors, the security rail, and the CI teeth that keep the ledger and the built estate from drifting. If any of these fail, nothing else on the page compensates. Walk these first, in any single hour you can find.

groups.lead: A desktop browser signed out for most cards; sign in for U-07 and X-13. Say the address before each verdict.

cards.title: The site stops saying it is operating
cards.context: No page may claim the cooperative is operating or its instruments ratified.
steps: Navigate to https://techne.coop/legal/. Confirm the instrument rows carry the drafted mark.
Open https://techne.coop/legal/#formation and read the notice; it should state the record's position in the counsel memo's words.
Spot-check the front page and /commons/ for any sentence claiming the cooperative is operating; there must be none.
cards.say: Say: “FORMATION-01 holds” and one sentence of what you saw, or “FORMATION-01 fails” and what broke.

cards.title: The correction log opens
cards.context: The correction log holds the estate's known wrong claims, each with its standing.
steps: Navigate to https://techne.coop/legal/corrections/.
Count the items (eight at drafting). For each, confirm it states what was claimed, what the record holds, and who closes it.
Confirm no item is marked closed without naming the closing act.
cards.say: Say: “DOC-01 holds” and one sentence of what you saw, or “DOC-01 fails” and what broke.

cards.title: The front door tells the truth
cards.context: A visitor must reach class self-selection in one step and enroll along an open track.
steps: From https://techne.coop/ click through to https://techne.coop/participation/ (one step from the front page).
Compare the four classes and their costs on the cards.
Navigate to https://techne.coop/commons/join/ and confirm the form offers class selection with labels bound to inputs and a live status line.
Confirm the legal instrument is linked from the page rather than restated in different words.
cards.say: Say: “U-10 holds” and one sentence of what you saw, or “U-10 fails” and what broke.

cards.title: The parked door
cards.context: The Share door is parked honestly: it names what is absent and whose act it waits on.
steps: Signed in, open the map and find the See your share group; click through to https://techne.coop/intranet/share/.
Confirm the page names S-01 and S-02, says the absence is the Board's pending act (not an administrator's withholding), and links the staged counting rules.
cards.say: Say: “U-07 holds” and one sentence of what you saw, or “U-07 fails” and what broke.

cards.title: One notice, one place
cards.context: One formation notice, one form: a footer line everywhere, no strips.
steps: Open https://techne.coop/legal/ and two or three pages beneath it (counsel memo, corrections).
Confirm none carries a formation strip block; each carries the one-line footer notice instead.
Open https://techne.coop/legal/#formation and confirm the long-form notice is intact.
cards.say: Say: “P-12 holds” and one sentence of what you saw, or “P-12 fails” and what broke.

cards.title: The documents agree
cards.context: The three module documents agree with the built estate.
steps: Open https://techne.coop/commons/patronage/ and confirm the tally surface address it names is /intranet/share/.
Open https://techne.coop/commons/treasury/ and confirm the public name it uses matches the treasury door's name in the shell.
Confirm each amendment line carries its date and piece address.
cards.say: Say: “X-13 holds” and one sentence of what you saw, or “X-13 fails” and what broke.

cards.title: The direction rail
cards.context: Directions enter by verb only; refusals cite rules. Proven by the RLS probe matrix.

cards.say: Say: “A-01 holds” and one sentence of what you saw, or “A-01 fails” and what broke.

cards.say: Say: “L-03 holds” and one sentence of what you saw, or “L-03 fails” and what broke.

cards.say: Say: “X-18 holds” and one sentence of what you saw, or “X-18 fails” and what broke.

cards.say: Say: “X-19 holds” and one sentence of what you saw, or “X-19 fails” and what broke.

cards.say: Say: “X-11 holds” and one sentence of what you saw, or “X-11 fails” and what broke.

groups.title: Tier two · the lexicon and the ledger

part.title: Structural instruments
part.blurb: The vocabulary, the ledger surface, and the estate’s own record of itself. A failure here is repairable and non-legal, but drift compounds; catch it now.

groups.title: Two-person pieces · 3 cards

part.kicker: with a second person · 3 pieces + 6 attestations
part.title: What no one walks alone
part.blurb: Two clusters that cannot be run alone. What each one proves is that a second person sees what you see, so a solo walk does not produce a weaker verdict; it produces no verdict at all. Book these when someone else is already in the room. Both clusters carry tier-one weight: the multi-player pieces prove the cooperative actually cooperates, and the attestations close whole beds. Order does not matter across clusters.

groups.lead: You and one other person, each signed in on your own device, in the same room or on a call. Open the two-person walkthrough script and work its acts; the three cards below are what those acts settle. Record as usual, and say who the second person is at the top: name and date, both of you.
groups.need: One person who is not you, with their own sign-in to the members’ side. Not a second browser profile of your own: the acceptance is about two people, and the record should be able to name the second one.

cards.title: Response flow
cards.context: Respond to a posting and both parties see it. A self-response is excluded by design, which is why this waits for a second person.
steps: You: signed in, open https://techne.coop/commons/postings/ and confirm a real posting is there, or make one.
The other person: signed in on their own device, open the same posting and respond to it.
They confirm aloud that they can see their own response.
You confirm aloud that you, the author, can see it too, without being told where to look.
cards.say: Say: “F-02 holds” and one sentence naming who responded, or “F-02 fails” and what broke.

cards.title: The scheduling act
cards.context: A member schedules a gathering and another member registers for it. The first half is yours; the second half is the reason this card is here.
steps: You: signed in, open https://techne.coop/commons/gatherings/ and schedule a real gathering with a title and a start.
Confirm it appears on the calendar with you as its host, carrying its purpose and its place.
The other person: on their own device, find that gathering and register for it.
Both of you confirm aloud that the registration shows.
cards.say: Say: “G-04 holds” and one sentence covering both clauses, or “G-04 fails” and which clause broke.

cards.title: The member’s rail
cards.context: A turn taken by one member lands as an event addressed to the member it concerns, and to no one else, seen without going to look.
steps: Do this immediately after F-02 and G-04, while the turns are fresh.
You: without navigating anywhere, look at the shell’s notices panel. The response and the registration must be there.
The other person: confirm on their device that they did not receive a notice for an event that does not concern them.
The restore clause (a replay mints no new notices) is proven in CI; witness the green run rather than re-running it, and say so.
cards.say: Say: “X-12 holds” and one sentence covering addressed-to and not-addressed-to, or “X-12 fails” and what broke.

groups.title: Attestations · 6 proofs
groups.lead: A proof is not walked; it is attested, by two hands, once every piece under it stands verified. So this runs last, and only for the proofs whose pieces the earlier tiers actually moved. Each one is a short act: read the pieces’ marks aloud, both of you agree the bed is whole, and both names go on the record with the date.
groups.need: A countersigning member, and the earlier tiers landed. For each proof below: if any piece under it did not hold, the proof is not ready, and saying so is the correct outcome.

cards.title: Belong proof
cards.context: Ready when B-02, B-04 and B-05 stand verified.
steps: Read B-02, B-04 and B-05 in the Maturation view.
If all three say verified, attest with both names; otherwise name the short piece.
cards.say: Say: “G-B attested” with both names and the date, or “G-B not ready” and which piece is short.

cards.title: Gather proof
cards.context: Ready when G-03 stands verified; G-04 is the sitting-five card above.
steps: Read G-03 and G-04 in the Maturation view.
Attest with both names, or name the short piece.
cards.say: Say: “G-G attested” with both names and the date, or “G-G not ready” and which piece is short.

cards.title: Find proof
cards.context: Ready when F-01, F-02 and F-03 stand verified. F-02 is the sitting-five card above, so this proof follows it directly.
steps: Read F-01, F-02 and F-03 in the Maturation view.
Attest with both names, or name the short piece.
cards.say: Say: “G-F attested” with both names and the date, or “G-F not ready” and which piece is short.

cards.title: The lexicon proof
cards.context: Ready when L-01 through L-06 stand verified. Five of the six are sitting-one and sitting-four cards, so this is usually the first proof to ripen.
steps: Read L-01 through L-06 in the Maturation view.
Attest with both names, or name the short piece.
cards.say: Say: “G-L attested” with both names and the date, or “G-L not ready” and which piece is short.

cards.title: Cross-cutting proof
cards.context: Ready when X-01 through X-09 stand verified.
steps: Read X-01 through X-09 in the Maturation view.
Attest with both names, or name the short piece.
cards.say: Say: “G-R attested” with both names and the date, or “G-R not ready” and which piece is short.

cards.title: The transducer proof
cards.context: Ready when TR-04 and TR-05 stand verified. The acceptance adds a step: the traced figure and the shown figure must agree, and the attestation must name both hands.
steps: Read TR-04 and TR-05 in the Maturation view.
Both of you open the HUD and compare the traced figure against the shown figure; they must agree.
Attest with both names, or name the short piece.
cards.say: Say: “G-I attested” with both names and the date, or “G-I not ready” and which piece is short.

groups.title: Coda · the walk about the walk
groups.lead: Speak this last, after every other tier has been walked or deferred.

cards.title: The verification walk
cards.context: This page. Its acceptance is that a walker needs nothing the page does not carry.
steps: At the end of your last sitting, say whether you ever had to ask for an instruction the page did not carry. That answer is this piece's verdict.
cards.say: Say: “X-22 holds” and one sentence of what you saw, or “X-22 fails” and what broke.
